dialogues.speaker: Aquabus Station Notice
dialogues.text: Welcome to the aquabus system! This station serves three lines. Passengers destined for Romaritime Harbor should take the Clementine Line.

dialogues.speaker: Aquabus Station Notice
dialogues.text: Passengers destined for the Opera Epiclese or Marcotte Station should take the Navia Line. Passengers destined for the Fontaine Research Institute should take the Callas Line.

dialogues.speaker: Aquabus Station Notice
dialogues.text: Special Notice: Due to force majeure, operations on the Callas Line are suspended indefinitely. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
